name: France
title: Holidays in France
intro: Mountains, lakes, islands and Paris. Here's where to go on holiday in France, how long to stay and the best time to visit.
seo_title: Where to go in France: the best places for a holiday

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit France?
faqs.answer: Late spring to early autumn suits most of France. Chamonix is also a ski resort in winter.

faqs.question: Where in France is good for the outdoors?
faqs.answer: Annecy and Chamonix for lakes and mountains, Corsica for beaches and hiking, and the Dordogne for canoeing and castles.

faqs.question: How long do you need in Paris?
faqs.answer: Three to five nights covers the big sights at an easy pace.
